campaign.title: The Kindly Cellar
campaign.premise: A rain-swollen river exposes unfinished business beneath an abandoned tollhouse.
campaign.current_horizon: Investigate the tollhouse before the river rises again.

objects.title: The Abandoned Tollhouse
objects.content: Rain rattles through a breached roof. The river door hangs open, the yard gate is half-collapsed, and muddy bootprints cross the main hall toward the records room.

objects.title: Mara Venn
objects.content: A weathered former tollhouse registrar. Mara wants the missing river ledger recovered before the old debts in it become public. She distrusts the harbor watch but will bargain honestly with anyone who protects the ferrymen.

data.description: A former tollhouse registrar who knows which debts were never settled.
data.appearance: Rain-dark auburn hair, gray eyes, a practical wool cloak, and a brass ledger clasp.

textBlocks.title: Ledger Memory
textBlocks.body: Mara can recall a debtor, date, or cargo from years of tollhouse work, but she will not expose a ferryman merely to satisfy curiosity.

objects.title: Tollhouse Rumors
objects.content: What travelers have heard about the abandoned tollhouse.

entries.text: The old bell rings whenever the river claims a name.
Someone still pays the toll after midnight.
The records room stayed dry during the great flood.

objects.title: The Name Mara Removed
objects.content: Mara removed her brother's name from the final ledger after he ferried refugees without paying the crown toll. The missing page can expose both the mercy and the forgery.

objects.title: Rising River
objects.content: Begin with steady rain. Add a low wooden groan whenever the party spends too long searching; after the third cue, water crosses the threshold.
